senses.en_definition: In my opinion; from my point of view.
With me; in my possession or care.
To or towards me, as the person an action or attitude is directed at.

messages.en: Have you still got the spare house key? I left my keys at the office.
Yeah, I've still got it. Just wait downstairs. I'm coming down now.

senses.en_definition: To or towards you, often expressing feelings or attitudes in an intimate or literary register.
With you; in your possession or care, or resting on you as a responsibility.

collocations.en: rests with you; is up to you

messages.en: I believe in you! You've prepared for this. Tomorrow, just answer like we practised earlier.
Wow, you're getting all sentimental! But I do feel a bit better hearing that. Pray for me, okay?
Shall we just play football on the school field this evening?
Sure. I've finished my homework. I'll bring the ball.

senses.en_definition: With him or her; in his or her possession or care.
On it; attached to its surface.
To or towards him or her, as the person an action or attitude is directed at.
In his or her opinion; from his or her point of view.

collocations.en: to them, it's a simple matter

messages.en: Have you got the meeting room key? I'm trying to open the door.
Try asking Farid. He might still have the key—he was the one who locked up yesterday.
